title: Our Town Hides When The WHISTLE Blows 📯
description:
When the town whistle blows, at noon or at midnight, everybody drops what they're doing and goes down to their basement until it stops. Nobody has ever seen what walks the street.

I'm twenty-four, and our basement had thirteen steps when I was born. Now it has twenty-six. My grandpa lives next door in the only house with no basement, and when the whistle blows, he makes tea.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
